newsitem.title: CHINA: China issues rule on luring foreign businesses.
newsitem.headline: China issues rule on luring foreign businesses.

text.p: China has issued new regulations aimed at stopping Chinese entities from offering unauthorised preferential policies to attract overseas investments, the China Business Daily said on Monday.

The new rules, issued recently by the State Administration for Industry and Commerce, forbid local governments from making unauthorised expansions of preferential treatment for foreign companies, the newspaper said.

Under the rules, Chinese entities may not guarantee loans to foreign businesses for capital stock or guarantee returns on investment. Chinese companies require an auditing of their assets before they join foreign partners in a joint venture, the newspaper said without elaborating.
New investments in service industries such as finance, insurance, foreign trade, shipping and tourism would have to be approved by the State Council, or cabinet, it said.

Foreign businesses involved in the transfer of advanced technology or the supply of raw materials that China was short of would be allowed to sell most of their products on domestic markets, it said without giving further details. There was no indication of whether this provision would mean any relaxation of existing rules.
